dedupe_keys.name: traficom communications open data frequencies stations broadband projects universal service areas and numbering finland

description: Traficom, Finland's transport and communications regulator, publishes its communications open data mostly through an OData v4 interface documented with Swagger, listed on its open data page and on the national portal avoindata.suomi.fi. Frequency data include the frequency allocation table, radio stations and TV stations in Finland (name, location, technical data and licence details, updated daily), maritime radio numbers, amateur call signs and frequencies available for radio microphones. Communications service data include information maps, broadband projects (construction and subsidy decision stages and companies) and universal service areas (service type, provider and location). Numbering data cover fixed and mobile number ranges, service numbers, operator codes and MNC codes. Cybersecurity data come from the National Cyber Security Centre's Autoreporter service, and sector statistics are downloadable as CSV under each chart on the Tieto.Traficom statistics site, together with Bittimittari broadband measurement data. Coverage: Finland. Format and access: OData v4 JSON, CSV and HTML tables, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: mobile base station locations and mobile coverage maps are not part of this open data; descriptions are mostly in Finnish. Simulation uses: broadcast station inventories for hazard exposure, broadband project and universal service areas for rural resilience studies, and sector demand statistics. Related records: the Traficom radio and TV station, Bittimittari and Autoreporter records describe key datasets, and the Nordic-Baltic statistics compare Finland with its neighbours.
